    // The support of a Minkowski sum: the farther spine endpoint along `direction`,
    // displaced by r along it.
    Support(c: Capsule3D, direction: Direction3D): Point3D
        => (direction.Vector.Dot(c.A.PositionVector) >= direction.Vector.Dot(c.B.PositionVector)
            ? c.A : c.B) + direction.Vector * c.Radius;

    //==
    // # Cylinder, pipe, cone, and frustum bodies
    //
    // Volume, surface area, bounds, centroid, containment and support bodies for the
    // axis-swept solids declared in `spatial-primitives.types.plato`. The capsule's
    // bodies are in the capsule section; the frame and disk-extent helpers, and the
    // conventions governing every body here, are in the shared primitives section.

    //==
    // # Cylinder
    //
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cylinder

    // pi * r^2 * h.
    Volume(c: Cylinder): Number
        => Number.Pi * c.Radius.Square * c.Height;

    // The lateral surface 2*pi*r*h PLUS both flat caps 2*pi*r^2, since the solid's
    // boundary includes them.
    SurfaceArea(c: Cylinder): Number
        => 2.0 * Number.Pi * c.Radius * c.Height + 2.0 * Number.Pi * c.Radius.Square;


    // TIGHT: the axial half-extent (h/2)|axis.e| plus the cap disk's own extent
    // r*sqrt(1 - (axis.e)^2) on each world axis e.
    Bounds(c: Cylinder): Bounds3D
    {
        var a = c.Axis.Vector;
        var disk = DiskHalfExtents(a, c.Radius);
        var half = c.Height * 0.5;
        return CenteredBounds(c.Center,
            half * a.X.Abs + disk.X,
            half * a.Y.Abs + disk.Y,
            half * a.Z.Abs + disk.Z);
    }

    // True when the query is within half the height along the axis AND within the
    // radius of the axis. Boundary inclusive on both.
    Contains(c: Cylinder, point: Point3D): Boolean
    {
        var v = c.Center.Between(point);
        return v.Dot(c.Axis.Vector).Abs <= c.Height * 0.5
            && PerpendicularComponent(v, c.Axis.Vector).MagnitudeSquared <= c.Radius.Square;
    }

    // The rim point of whichever cap faces `direction`: the axial extreme plus the
    // radial extreme, chosen independently.
    Support(c: Cylinder, direction: Direction3D): Point3D
    {
        var a = c.Axis.Vector;
        var d = direction.Vector;
        var axial = a * (d.Dot(a) >= 0.0 ? c.Height * 0.5 : c.Height * -0.5);
        return c.Center + axial + RadialSupport(d, a, c.Radius);
    }

    //==
    // # CylindricalShell

    // pi * h * (R^2 - r^2).
    Volume(s: CylindricalShell): Number
        => Number.Pi * s.Height * (s.OuterRadius.Square - s.InnerRadius.Square);

    // Both lateral surfaces 2*pi*h*(R + r) plus the two annular caps
    // 2*pi*(R^2 - r^2). The inner wall is part of the solid's boundary.
    SurfaceArea(s: CylindricalShell): Number
        => 2.0 * Number.Pi * s.Height * (s.OuterRadius + s.InnerRadius)
        + 2.0 * Number.Pi * (s.OuterRadius.Square - s.InnerRadius.Square);


    // The outer cylinder's bounds, which the shell touches everywhere.
    Bounds(s: CylindricalShell): Bounds3D
    {
        var a = s.Axis.Vector;
        var disk = DiskHalfExtents(a, s.OuterRadius);
        var half = s.Height * 0.5;
        return CenteredBounds(s.Center,
            half * a.X.Abs + disk.X,
            half * a.Y.Abs + disk.Y,
            half * a.Z.Abs + disk.Z);
    }

    // True when the query is within half the height along the axis AND its distance
    // from the axis lies in [InnerRadius, OuterRadius].
    Contains(s: CylindricalShell, point: Point3D): Boolean
    {
        var v = s.Center.Between(point);
        var radialSquared = PerpendicularComponent(v, s.Axis.Vector).MagnitudeSquared;
        return v.Dot(s.Axis.Vector).Abs <= s.Height * 0.5
            && radialSquared >= s.InnerRadius.Square
            && radialSquared <= s.OuterRadius.Square;
    }

    //==
    // # Cone
    //
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cone

    // The centre of the base disk: Apex displaced by Height along Axis.
    BaseCenter(c: Cone): Point3D
        => c.Apex + c.Axis.Vector * c.Height;

    // The slant height sqrt(r^2 + h^2).
    SlantHeight(c: Cone): Number
        => (c.Radius.Square + c.Height.Square).Sqrt;

    // (1/3) * pi * r^2 * h.
    Volume(c: Cone): Number
        => Number.Pi * c.Radius.Square * c.Height / 3.0;

    // The lateral surface pi*r*l PLUS the base disk pi*r^2, since the base closes
    // the solid.
    SurfaceArea(c: Cone): Number
        => Number.Pi * c.Radius.Square + Number.Pi * c.Radius * c.SlantHeight;

    // On the axis, three quarters of the way from the Apex to the base — i.e. one
    // quarter of the height above the base, the standard solid-cone result.
    Centroid(c: Cone): Point3D
        => c.Apex + c.Axis.Vector * (0.75 * c.Height);

    // TIGHT: the union of the Apex and the base disk's own bounds.
    Bounds(c: Cone): Bounds3D
        => UnionOfBounds(Bounds3D(c.Apex, c.Apex),
            DiskBounds(c.BaseCenter, c.Axis.Vector, c.Radius));

    // True when the query lies between the Apex and the base plane AND within the
    // cone's radius at that height, which grows linearly as r*t/h. Boundary
    // inclusive.
    Contains(c: Cone, point: Point3D): Boolean
    {
        var v = c.Apex.Between(point);
        var t = v.Dot(c.Axis.Vector);
        return t >= 0.0 && t <= c.Height
            && PerpendicularComponent(v, c.Axis.Vector).Magnitude <= c.Radius * t / c.Height;
    }

    // Either the Apex or the extreme point of the base rim, whichever is farther
    // along `direction`. Exact because the cone is the convex hull of those two
    // features.
    Support(c: Cone, direction: Direction3D): Point3D
    {
        var d = direction.Vector;
        var rim = c.BaseCenter + RadialSupport(d, c.Axis.Vector, c.Radius);
        return d.Dot(c.Apex.PositionVector) >= d.Dot(rim.PositionVector) ? c.Apex : rim;
    }

    //==
    // # ConicalFrustum
    //
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frustum

    // The centre of the bottom disk, at -Height/2 along Axis.
    BottomCenter(f: ConicalFrustum): Point3D
        => f.Center - f.Axis.Vector * (f.Height * 0.5);
